# Conformance cases excluded from the automatic CI and nightly matrix.
#
# Every other case in testdata/ runs on every push to main and every night.
# A case listed here does not - it is run on demand, by naming it in the
# debug-conformance workflow, which takes explicit case names and ignores this
# file.
#
# This exists so a resource that cannot be covered for free still gets covered.
# Without it the choice is between no conformance case at all and adding
# recurring spend to every run, and the first option is how types end up
# shipping broken - a fifth of this plugin's types had no case, and writing the
# first one for a type found a real defect almost every time.
#
# List a case here only for a reason that survives being written down: it costs
# real money to hold, it mutates something shared, or the API cannot be made to
# accept it at all. Slowness alone is not a reason; that is what the per-case
# timeouts are for. Neither is "it is failing" - a failing case is a bug to fix,
# and the only admissible version of that reason is a demonstrated, written-down
# refusal on the provider's side.
#
# One case name per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.

# A PRODUCTION Bigtable instance with two clusters bills per node per hour, and
# a DEVELOPMENT instance - which the other Bigtable cases use - cannot have a
# second cluster at all, so there is no cheap way to exercise this type.
bigtable-cluster

# analyticshub queryTemplates.create cannot be satisfied through the v1 REST API.
# Validation runs routine present -> definitionBody non-empty -> "Query template
# routine name should be same as the template name.", and nothing in the request
# carries a routine name: the v1 discovery document gives Routine exactly two
# fields, routineType and definitionBody, and the API rejects name, routineId,
# routineName, routineReference and routine_name as unknown. Probed 2026-09-03
# against development-477117 with the queryTemplateId matching the routine name,
# with a CREATE TABLE FUNCTION body naming it (bare, backticked and fully
# qualified), and with a real TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION shared into the clean room by
# a listing with restricted egress. Every one returns the same refusal, so this
# is an upstream gap and not something the fixture can express. The plugin code
# is complete; run the case on demand once the API accepts a create.
analyticshub-query-template
